reuse.why: Extends the existing getScheduledAmount helper that the server sites already call, reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance, and moves the template's own midpoint copy onto the helper.

duplication.why: The rule is written once in getScheduledAmount; the only residue is the template site's own `isbetween || isapprox ? getScheduledAmount(...) : value` dispatch, which repeats a decision the helper already makes.

placement.why: The worst-case rule stays in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount (with its doc comment updated) and the tolerance comes from shared/rules.ts.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the helper, its callers passing op, the API field, tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: A single, documented definition owns the rule; the boolean-then-op positional signature (`getScheduledAmount(x, false, op)`) and the template's leftover dispatch are minor wrinkles.

bypasses_abstraction.where: createScheduleList in server/budget/schedule-template.ts still decides by op which amounts go through getScheduledAmount instead of passing every amount to it.

disguised_duplication.where: No reshaped copy; the tolerance is taken from getApproxNumberThreshold and the range rule exists only in getScheduledAmount.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount (shared/schedules.ts) gains an optional op parameter and an isapprox branch; createScheduleList in schedule-template.ts keeps its own op-based dispatch around the call.
